node.statement: Non-generating admissible rows (k = ord_n(p) < e): (O1) FALSE by 2^{Theta(n)} twice over — THEOREM ADM-B (LEMMA 3 ratio k/e, t-naming-independent) and THEOREM Z-3 (object-level: Z(L) >= 2^{m(1-(k/e)(tL/n))}), exhibit p = 3 2^41+1 q = p^6 with matching exponents 2^{5n/12}; the F2 lane needs a generation hypothesis the rules do not supply (MAINTAINER, open). Generating rows (exactly three classes by G1/G2): THEOREM Z2 — at k = e LEMMA 3's requirement IS the balance tL >= n, so (O1) survives under the full-subset calibration (C) (<= 184 bits slack) and is FALSE by 2^{n/(L^2 ln 2)} >= 2^{4.84e7} under the exact slice calibration (T*); the 0.0044% between them (banked twice as agreement) is the SIGN of (O1) at zero margin. Kill is parity-reading-A-only; CATCH-H: A is internally forced (proved K1/K2/G trichotomy + the lane's own min(m_j, t/2) text); CATCH-G: the (O1)=>(O2) fence demands the slice — the lane's internal logic points at the false cell. Minimal surviving form: E_{K1}[T_W] = 2^{n/2} Z_1^e exactly, (O1) iff Z_1 <= 2^{o(n)/e}, subject to the two unpinned conventions. FOUR-FACE SEAM: balance = LEMMA 3 = Z-FLOOR vacuity boundary = PP5.0 avg-vs-sum, one inequality on k = e rows; campaign working convention (coordinator ruling 2026-08-06, stricter-reading clause, flagged for maintainer): the SUM reading, both pricings carried. NOT claimed: (O1) itself on generating rows; the maintainer pins; any Z_1 upper bound. Provenance: notes/pilots_20260806/{f2_adm, z1_ternary_mass, o1_generating_adversary}, all coordinator-replayed.
